messages:
alex.m: SFO2 is live from provisioning. We need a compact first-responder orientation tomorrow 09:30 PT to hand off alerts, PD flows, and the quick checks. Can everyone attend?

maya.k: I can make 09:30. paste the micro-checklist here so i can skim.

alex.m: Micro-checklist i'll ask you to run during the handoff:
- control-plane quick: `kubectl --context=sfo2 get pods -n redwood-system --no-headers`
- node roster + allocatable: `kubectl --context=sfo2 get nodes -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,GPU:.status.allocatable`
- NVMe health: `ssh node-?? 'smartctl -H /dev/nvme0n1'` (sample script in sfo2/tools/nvme_health.sh)
- GPU probe: `sfo2/tools/probe_gpu_nodes.sh`
- BGP adjacencies: `birdc sfo2 show adj` and check `/var/log/bgp-events.log`
- egress sanity: tail `logs/fw-conntrack.log` for recent drops

lee.s: Important: differentiate PD for driver faults vs fabric issues. We'll be explicit in the PD doc.

samir: Paste GPU probe snippet?

alex.m: probe_gpu_nodes.sh snippet:
`````
for n in $(kubectl --context=sfo2 get nodes -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}'); do
  if [[ "$n" =~ gpu ]]; then
    kubectl --context=sfo2 debug -it $n -- nvidia-smi -L || echo "$n: probe-fail"
  fi
 done
`````

maya.k: If probe reports fail, what's first responder's action? Reboot / cordon or escalate?

lee.s: For week-1 ops: cordon -> drain -> attempt `systemctl restart nvidia-drm` -> if still failing, reprovision. Escalate to infra after two driver restarts or 15m unresolved.

alex.m: Initial PD mapping (short names):
- infra-gpu-pd: SLO-impacting GPU/node failures -> infra primary -> infra-leads
- k8s-control-pd: api/etcd issues -> platform-sre
- netops-pd: BGP/egress/flap -> netops team
- cost-ops-pd: billing spikes or autoscale runaway -> finance + ops

oncall-bot: Deploy sfo2-control v1.3.7 passed poststart checks. :white_check_mark:

maya.k: Owners? who edits the runbook source vs PD mappings?

alex.m: Owners: eng-infra owns runbook text (`infra-playbooks/sfo2.md`), platform-sre owns PD configs (`ops-configs/pd-maps`), eng-oncall owns the escalation matrix doc. PRs for runbook changes go to infra-playbooks; PD mapping PRs to ops-configs and require platform-sre review.

samir: Networking gotcha: SFO2 uses split egress paths. If primary NIC shows >8% error rate for 5m or BGP withdraw bursts >3/min, page `netops-pd` immediately. Also watch for high ARP churn on the top-of-rack switches.

lee.s: Add autoscaler runaway rule: if node group adds >10 nodes in 12m, page `infra-gpu-pd`.

alex.m: Capacity notes: 28 A100s (mixed 40/80), autoscaler min=8 max=48 initially. Billing guard at 75% of commit -> post to `finance-alerts` and pages `cost-ops-pd` when projected > commit. Hard autoscale ceiling tied to reserved pool.

ops-trainer: Orientation plan for 09:30 PT (30m):
- 8m: architecture + capacity constraints + cost guardrails
- 8m: live demo: micro-checklist + probe script + nvme check
- 7m: synthetic alert drill (we'll trigger a fake infra-gpu-pd)
- 5m: PD ack/escalation demo + forced-ack walkthrough
- 2m: Q&A and signoff

maya.k: i'll produce the 1-page responder cheat (4 cmds + PD links) and upload to the playbook.

alex.m: Training drill will be recorded. ops-trainer will post recording and quick cheat to the playbook.

samir: DNS note: internal DNS TTL is short (30s). you will see transient failures during scale events. If a service shows >1% DNS failures over 5m, classify as degraded and follow retry guidance.

lee.s: Also, label expectation: all nodes must have `node-role.kubernetes.io/gpu=true` and `cloud-zone=sfo2`. If labels missing after reprovision, that's a reprovision bug.

alex.m: Action items: alex.m -> update owners + PD map PR by EOD; maya.k -> cheat sheet + join 09:30; ops-trainer -> run drill + upload; lee.s -> add autoscaler alert PR; samir -> add NVMe and BGP thresholds to playbook.

maya.k: acked, i'll be on the call and will validate PD forced-ack flows before the drill.

oncall-bot: Reminder: SFO2 first-responder orientation in ~24h — https://meet.redwood/sfo2-orient

alex.m: thanks team. we'll finalize handoff in the sprint ticket after the drill.
